intro.text: A game of throws played on Roshar. Kaladin and his family played it during his youth in Hearthstone.
A Vorin betting game played with stones, common in gambling dens and among darkeyes. Players bet only on the hand they hold once all the throws and draws are done.

description.text: Three throws are known: the tower, three pairs, which loses outright; the queen, two trios, which wins outright; and the butcher, a trio and a pair, which may win or lose depending on the other throws.
The game uses stones, with throws, tosses and draws. Because Vorins fear foretelling the future, nobody bets on the parts left to chance, only on the hand they end with.

items.text: Kaladin played breakneck with his family as a boy in Hearthstone.
In a Bornwater firemoss den, Szeth watched people play breakneck and thought the Vorin attitude to the game odd.
In disguise, Shallan was so good at breakneck, played for chips in Urithiru's bars, that few would face her. She got caught up in a game at Jez's Duty during a wedding celebration.
